new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Arabian Ranches?

From about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Private dining Arabian Ranches evenings for smaller groups sit higher per head, while ten or more guests bring the rate down toward AED 700. Send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of Arabian Ranches do you serve?

All of it — Arabian Ranches 1, 2 and 3, villas around the Arabian Ranches Golf Club and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire and we verify gate access ahead of the day.
What's included with a private chef Arabian Ranches booking?
A vetted chef, all fresh ingredients, menu design, cooking, plating, service staff where needed, and full setup and cleanup. Everything is handled so you can host as a guest at your own table.
Can you cater a dinner party or larger event at my villa?
Yes. Arabian Ranches dinner party catering is our most-booked format, and we scale up to garden BBQs, grazing tables and buffets for parties and events with dedicated staffing to match.
Do you offer halal and dietary-specific menus?

Yes. Halal, vegetarian, vegan and allergen-aware menus are built in from the start, and every dish is agreed with you before the chef shops, so the menu fits every guest at your table. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
Can I request a female private chef in Arabian Ranches?

Yes. A female chef can be requested for your booking. Tell us when you enquire and myCHEF matches you with a female chef from the partner network for your date, cuisine and service style. It is a regular request across the Ranches — family villas where the chef is in the house all evening, and women-only gatherings where the host would rather it were a woman cooking. Availability depends on the date and the cuisine, so mention it in your first message and we confirm the match before you commit.
How do I book a chef for hire in Arabian Ranches?
Share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day. Approve it and the chef handles the rest, from shopping to cleanup.
For private chef arabian ranches, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
